subject: Escalation: Maple Health — request to include onboarding & premium support in deal + PS discount
messages:
From: Alex Herman <alex.herman@maplehealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Liu <susan.liu@maplehealth.com>, procurement@maplehealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:34 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — onboarding + premium support question

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the initial quote. Two asks from my side so we can move to procurement quickly:

1) Can you include a bundled onboarding package (3 months) + premium support (6 months) as part of the initial deal rather than as an add-on? Our team wants the concierge onboarding + faster SLAs for the first 6 months.
2) If you include that package, would Redwood consider a one-time discount on professional services (we're looking at 12-month commitment, ~10M tokens/month) — our finance team is asking for a reduction to make the numbers work.

I've attached our RFP and the draft SOW we had in-house (MapleHealth_SOW_v3.pdf). Procurement will need SOW + final pricing to process.

Can you confirm what level of discount and support you can offer and whether any non-standard SLA credits or change-order language will be required?

Thanks,
Alex

Attachments: MapleHealth_RFP.pdf, MapleHealth_SOW_v3.pdf

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Herman <alex.herman@maplehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — onboarding + premium support question

Alex — thanks for the clarity and the attach. We're excited about the opportunity with Maple Health.

Quick summary from my side: we can absolutely bundle a 3-month onboarding engagement and 6 months of Premium Support. I need to escalate the PS discount and the non-standard SOW terms (change-order and SLA credit language) to RevOps + Legal for sign-off.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll put together an internal ask for approval by EOD 2/18.
- If approved, we'll send an updated pricing summary + SOW for DocuSign.
- Would procurement like to set a target margin or target discount? If you can share a target, I can try to work to it when I escalate.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I'll keep you posted.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Dylan: (415) 555-0198

Attachments: pricing_summary.xlsx (placeholder)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:20:03 -0800
Subject: Escalation: Maple Health — request for PS discount + bundled support (need exec sign-off)

Team —

Maple Health (regional health system, mid-Market) is asking to include:
- 3-month onboarding package (concierge, TAM-led)
- 6 months Premium Support (SLA 4hr P1)
- Custom connector work (EHR integration) estimated ~120 eng hours

They are requesting a one-time 25% discount on Professional Services fees if we include the bundle in the initial contract. Deal size: expected $250k ARR initial year, PS bucket ~$80k pre-discount.

Risks / non-standard items:
- Non-standard SLA credit language requested by procurement (explicit credits for <48hr uptime windows)
- SOW must include a clear change-order process and a cap on scope for the custom connector work

Ask:
1) Approval to offer 25% off PS fees for the initial engagement and include 6-month Premium Support at no additional recurring charge for the first year.
2) Approval on the proposed SOW caps: 120 eng hours for connector; additional work to be handled via change order with pre-approved rates.
3) Sign-off on a limited SLA credit clause: up to 10% of monthly recurring for qualifying outages (time-limited, not open-ended).

Attachments: pricing_summary.xlsx (I put redline suggestions inline)

Please advise — Alex expects an updated SOW/pricing by end of week.

Thanks,
Dylan

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Maple Health — request for PS discount + bundled support (need exec sign-off)

Dylan — thanks for the summary. A few notes: 

- I can provisionally approve a discount but prefer 20% vs 25% on PS fees unless Marketing/RevOps absorbs the delta. If this is a strategic healthcare logo worth platform credibility, we can be more flexible.
- The SLA credit language needs to be tightened: we should not agree to open-ended credits tied to uptime without a cap and a defined incident review window. Suggest: cap credits to 10% of the monthly MRR and require written incident reports within 14 days.
- Approve the 120 eng hours cap on the connector scope; any work beyond that must be a documented change order with PO.

If Marissa concurs, I can sign off and loop Legal for final SOW wording.

cc: marissa_cole for final approval.

-karthik

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Feb 2026 09:02:21 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Maple Health — request for PS discount + bundled support (need exec sign-off)

All — reviewed. Approvals and conditions below: 

1) Approve 25% discount on Professional Services for the initial engagement only (one-time). This is to win the logo.
2) Approve inclusion of 3-month onboarding + 6 months Premium Support at no additional recurring charge for the first contract year.
3) SOW must include:
   - 120 engineering hour cap for the custom connector; additional hours billed at standard PS rates via change order.
   - Change-order approval path (sales -> client PO -> RevOps approval).
   - SLA credit: capped at 10% of the monthly recurring revenue; incidents to be documented and reviewed within 14 days. No open-ended financial exposure.
4) Procurement & Legal to run final SOW redline; RevOps will prepare the DocuSign envelope with the approved SOW.

I will sign off on the non-standard terms so you can move forward with procurement. Send Final_SOW_for_Signature.pdf and I'll get the DocuSign envelope out today.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Final_SOW_for_Signature.pdf

From: Alex Herman <alex.herman@maplehealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, procurement@maplehealth.com
Cc: Susan Liu <susan.liu@maplehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 17:45:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — onboarding + premium support question

Dylan — thanks and appreciate the fast turnaround. Maple Health accepts the terms as outlined in the Final SOW (3-month onboarding, 6 months premium support, 25% one-time PS discount, 120-hr connector cap, SLA credit cap). Procurement will complete the DocuSign routing this afternoon.

Please let me know the onboarding kickoff dates and any pre-kickoff deliverables we should prepare.

Thanks,
Alex

Attachments: none
